results.step: No account needed: nothing is loaded from Supabase until Settings
Email magic link: sends the link with the site’s redirect address
Opening the link signs in (PKCE code exchange) and returns to Settings
Turn on sync: first device gets a library code; rows are encrypted, one per book
Second device: Continue with Google signs in to the same account
Sync asks for the library code; a wrong code is refused, the right one works
Notes arrive on the second device, labelled with the book even before it’s added
After adding the same book, it opens at the first device’s reading place
An edit on the second device reaches the first
Changes sync automatically a few seconds after you make them
Reload keeps you signed in and sync on
Sign out: email gone, sync off, notes stay on the device; no Supabase calls on next launch
Empty configuration: no sign-in UI, no requests, everything else works
Supabase or its CDN unreachable: sign-in is disabled with a note; no errors
